C-01.1.answer: An absent spend index (no spend/files.json) is the case this branch fixes: the overview now returns indexed_at null and the card shows a dash with the sakk spend hint, never $0.00 read from a day file that was never written.

C-01.2.answer: Deleting files.json, or backdating its mtime to yesterday, flips the new overview test from counted to not counted; the guard asserts both states, so removing the check turns the test red rather than leaving it PASS.
C-01.2.guard: test/console.test.mjs::an uncounted day shows a dash, not $0, until sakk spend counts it (F-231)

C-02.1.answer: No hand list: the rule is one predicate on the index's own last-count time (files.json mtime, rewritten on every count) compared with today in the configured zone, applied to the only reader that shows today's figure.
C-02.1.guard: test/console.test.mjs::an uncounted day shows a dash, not $0, until sakk spend counts it (F-231)

C-02.2.answer: Other readers of today's total: sakk spend refreshes the index itself before reading, and the hook's cap check also refreshes before deciding, so the console's Today card is the only reader that showed an uncounted day as zero; the stale-index case (counted yesterday, no cap set) is covered too.
C-02.2.guard: test/console.test.mjs::an uncounted day shows a dash, not $0, until sakk spend counts it (F-231)
